title: Procurement Operations Internship
description:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

Our cars have finally arrived in Europe, and with several markets on our expansion roadmap, there has never been a better time to join the team.

Internship details

•
Start date: February 2027.

•
Allowance: €800 per month (based on 40 hours per week).

Mission for the internship:

As a Procurement Operations Intern, you will join our Procurement team and support key sourcing, purchasing, and supplier management activities across the business. You will help optimize procurement processes, manage supplier data, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and contribute to sourcing projects that ensure efficient and cost-effective operations.

This internship provides hands-on experience across procurement operations, sourcing project coordination, and process optimization — ideal for students interested in supply chain, purchasing, or vendor management.

What you will learn:
During this internship, you will gain valuable exposure to procurement and supply chain operations:

•
How sourcing projects are structured, tracked, and executed in a real business environment.

•
Practical experience with the Purchase Order lifecycle and procurement systems.

•
Supplier management and vendor onboarding processes.

•
Stakeholder communication across procurement, finance, and business teams.

•
How to independently manage small sourcing initiatives.

•
Procurement process improvement and workflow optimization.

•
Tools such as Excel, procurement trackers, and internal workflow solutions.

Key educational requirement:

•
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, or related fields.

•
Strong organizational and analytical skills.

•
Interest in procurement, sourcing, and vendor management.

•
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

•
Solid communication skills for engaging with suppliers and internal teams.

•
Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with procurement or project management tools is a plus.

To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.
